summary: Narrow riverside park track through scrub, no clear spot for a van.
reasons: Steep sections, likely closed to the public

drivers.seclusion: Very secluded: scrub and the Brisbane River on one side, a construction site and university on the other, no dwellings near.
drivers.access_and_room: A narrow dirt track runs through trees along the river bank; no clearing or widening wide enough for a van to stop clear of the track, and one vehicle in the QLD image looks like a park maintenance vehicle.
drivers.traffic: Almost none; the mapped road, Discovery Drive, is 61 m away.
drivers.convention: No campervans or tyre marks beyond the single vehicle on the track; mapped car parks nearby belong to the university.

flags: Brisbane River 154 m away, low-lying bank at about 17-19 m
Track probably gated or park-managed; mapped gates 114 m and further
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over most of the track; shaded from the west and north.
rubbish: Building rubble and materials on the construction land to the west, not on the track.
cannot_judge: Whether the track is open to vehicles
Gate or barrier at the track ends
